scope: Native per-page formatted text, Markdown and HTML
qualification: Bounded tested adapters, not general semantic or visual qualification

diagnostic_policy.source_records: Complete bounded native diagnostics retain source SHA256, original native page/category/message/spec_section and one-based page attribution. Records are not drained or discarded.
diagnostic_policy.operator_cap_exceeded: Affected pages and the file manifest set truncated=true and partial=true; the Job is partial with an explicit content-omission warning. A native diagnostic with page=null applies conservatively to every selected page. Both native extraction baselines and formatted outputs can be incomplete.
diagnostic_policy.no_text_layer: Affected pages set ocr_required=true and partial=true. The file and Job are partial because this route does not run OCR. This diagnostic alone does not claim truncation.
diagnostic_policy.glyph_dropped_and_image_suppressed: If these native loss categories occur, preserve them in page/file omitted_content_categories and mark the affected pages, file and Job partial. They do not imply operator truncation. Synthetic diagnostic contract tests cover these signals; the current no-image/no-rasterization formatter does not naturally emit them.
diagnostic_policy.other_warnings: Preserved in structured_warnings and surfaced in the Job warnings; warnings alone do not imply a truncation category.
diagnostic_policy.budget_failure: Character, diagnostic and output budget failures abort the file; no partial files are published.
diagnostic_policy.regression: Real synthetic PDF with 1,000,010 T* operators and independently visible numeric tail reproduces native truncation in text, Markdown and HTML. Tests require partial state, page/file flags, raw diagnostics, intact source hashes, omitted-tail evidence and correct page-selection scope. Mixed text/scan pages verify page-specific OCR status.

capabilities.limits: 100 selected pages, 500000 total baseline/output characters, shared 16MiB output budget and native process bounds.
capabilities.accuracy: Pinned untagged geometric plain-text path ignores include_artifacts=False on the frozen tagged-artifact fixture; this combination is rejected before worker creation. No form-field toggle exists in this binding. Original native text is retained in a separate baseline file. Numeric tokens tested against the frozen authored-cell oracle. No layout or order qualification is implied.

Actual tagged-artifact and form-field toggles checked; untouched baseline retained. All numeric fixture cells checked. Native inferred tables and reading order require source comparison. Native images disabled; explicit bounded PNG export is separate.

No include_artifacts toggle exists in native HTML; exclusion rejected. Raw native output remains inert .native-html.txt; browser review permits structural tags only, with all native attributes/styles/images/links/active content removed. It is a content review, not layout reproduction.

capabilities.reason: Explicit selected-page iteration retains per-page source identity, bounds and errors. Native convenience all-page accumulation and async executor wrappers are not called. Images are not embedded in native text/HTML conversion; oxide offers separately bounded inspection/export.

preserved_native_failure: Isolated cloud evidence/format-artifact-probe retains original.pdf and plain-text outputs with both artifact flag values; original files are not overwritten.
preserved_diagnostic_failure: Isolated cloud evidence/format-diagnostics-20261016-v1 retains the original operator-cap PDF, independent extraction/render, baseline completed/truncated=false report and distinct corrected partial reports. This is synthetic evidence, not broader acceptance.
parent_ada_acceptance: pending for this new route; existing extraction failures already confirmed independently
